description: Close an open CEX futures position (or reduce it) with a reduce-only market order. Real money. Needs the trade:execute scope. EXITS ARE NEVER BLOCKED BY THE KILL SWITCH (owner decision D4): a close, a reduce-only order and a cancel always pass, and the switch plus autonomy=propose_only stop only NEW positions. NEVER touch positions the user marked manual unless explicitly asked.

connectionId.description: CEX connection id (see list_connections). Takes precedence over exchange.

size.description: Size to close, in the unit the positions tool reported for this venue — contracts on OKX swaps, the contract's own size on Kraken, base units elsewhere. Omit to close the whole leg on the named side: okx, binance, bybit, bitget, gateio, kucoin, bingx and kraken close it, mexc and coinbase refuse (no close path). Or pass a smaller amount to reduce partially
